projection: Web Mercator (EPSG:3857): columns are equal steps in longitude, rows equal steps in Mercator y (not latitude); row 0 is north

img.composition: Resampled from the real USGSImageryOnly tiles of every mirrored zoom <= 13, painted coarse to fine (finer zoom wins where it has data; upstream transparency respected). The service answers 404 for zoom 10 itself, so no zoom-10 tile is used unless listed in layers.
img.fill: No imagery is invented. Pixels with no imagery at any mirrored zoom are neutral deep blue rgb(11,42,74).

qa.note: hillshade (sun NW, land exaggerated 6x, sea 1.2x) of dem_z10.png, 0 m contour in red

sources.dem: AWS Terrain Tiles (Mapzen/Tilezen Terrarium; USGS 3DEP on land, GEBCO/ETOPO1 bathymetry), https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/ ; re-encoded, heights quantised to 0.5 m
sources.img: USGS The National Map: USGSImageryOnly (public domain), https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSImageryOnly/MapServer
